name: Jim Boyd

items.why: The item says nothing was found on foreign ties (criterion 2), and my own searches found no foreign-agent, foreign-government or foreign-money conduct by Boyd, so there is no conduct to weigh.

The one search naming the owner's sites returned nothing from alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org or infowars.com. I didn't read FARA filings or Florida lobbyist and ethics records directly, so a person could check them. AIPAC-related money and trips are handled in a separate step. The Tampa Free Press item on Boyd's tort-reform award and his insurance-industry career could be checked under the big-money criterion (3), but nothing I read alleged wrongdoing. I didn't use it.
